title: Insert welcome message into homepage hero section

requirements.summary: Display the provided multi-paragraph welcome message directly under the main hero title and above the existing subtitle/tagline on the homepage.
acceptanceCriteria: On the home page (Hero section), the welcome message appears immediately after the main H1 shop title and before the existing line "Your trusted partner for professional document services in Delhi".
The welcome message text matches the user-provided message exactly (including punctuation, emojis, and line breaks/paragraphs where applicable).
The welcome message is readable and visually consistent with the current design (centered in the hero content block and responsive on mobile and desktop).

file_operations.description: In the Hero section content block, insert a new text element immediately after the H1 "Sheikh Mohammad Saad Document Center" and before the existing subtitle paragraph. Render the welcome message exactly as provided, preserving line breaks/paragraphs (e.g., via a single string with newline characters and styling that respects them such as whitespace-pre-line). Keep the message centered and responsive with Tailwind classes consistent with the existing hero typography, and do not modify any other page content.
